purpose: Document city-local registry evidence and schema-first anonymous public geometry review.
assessment: Blida’s official provincial directory lists both land-cadastre and land-conservation offices. This supports local registry/cadastral administration, but no anonymous parcel geometry service or safe feature schema was verified. No private registry lookup or cadastral-document request was made.
registryAssessment: The official Blida Directorate of Commerce page republishes the Wilaya of Blida directory and explicitly lists the provincial Land Cadastre and Topography Directorate and Land Conservation office with local telephone contacts. This is evidence of the responsible local land/cadastre institutions in Blida; it does not establish a public vector service or the precise coverage of the WUP locator.
